The two failed missions each implicate different subsets of players: Mission 2 (Alice, Charlie, Bob) and Mission 3 (Diana, Eve). In contrast, Alice???Charlie was a clean team on Mission 1, only turning bad once Eve and Bob were added on Mission 2, and Bob has only appeared on that single failed mission. Every possible evil pair is {A,D}, {A,E}, {C,D}, or {C,E}. There is no team of 3 that can avoid all four possibilities, so no choice is logically guaranteed safe on information alone. In that spot, the best practical heuristic is to repeat the last successful team that returned 0 FAIL cards, which is Alice/Bob/Diana on Mission 4. That mission gave us the only fully clean result with three players and excluded both Charlie and Eve, the two players whose presence correlates most directly with the failed missions.
